      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author benchmarked the immutable approach, found sv2-tp latency regressions due to IPC bottlenecks, and suggested deferring",
      "author_replies": ["c:6380417140", "c:6408317995", "c:6491583234", "c:6492816419"],

      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Make the template immutable now rather than adding a temporary mutex, as 2.5ms to 6ms is an acceptable latency cost",

      "status_by_id": "c:6808028212",
      "status_by_quote": "That said, I don’t feel strongly about. I am fine with it being a future follow up."
    }
